translations.web: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
translations.bsb: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
translations.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
translations.asv: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
